title: Comparison of tower purity with reconstructed-trace purity
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite coefficient fields inside a fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For each finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ write $R_{E,W}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\lim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], let $\mathbf1_{E,W}=R_{E,W}$, and put $T_E=\mathbf1_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Work in the derived-complete constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with completed tensor and pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Put $P_E=Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}$ and $G_E=Rf^!_{\mathcal O_E}$, with the specified constructible adjunction and counit $\epsilon_E$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix one compactification of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use its canonical projection-formula isomorphisms [def-exchange-projection] and the canonical realization comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization].

Let $\delta_E:H_{f,\mathcal O_E}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E$ be the unique counit-preserving comparison of right adjoints [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], where $H_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ has the realized tower adjunction of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ define the actual integral tower map
$$\gamma^T_{E,K}=\delta_{E,K}\circ R\lim\bigl(\gamma_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK)\bigr):Lf_E^*K(d)[2d]\longrightarrow G_EK,$$
using the diagonal orientation and tensor transpose of [det-sp-tower-gamma] and the canonical source realization. Here the tower levels $\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and the uniformizer levels are identified by their canonical cofinal reduction/limit comparisons. Put $a^T_E=\gamma^T_{E,\mathbf1_{E,Y}}:T_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E\mathbf1_{E,Y}$.

Write $0$ for the coefficient field $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Choose any integral isomorphism $g_0:T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}G_0\mathbf1_{0,Y}$ whose finite reductions, under the specified reduction comparisons, are the unit-object purity maps of [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction, def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. Define $t_0=\epsilon_{0,\mathbf1}\circ P_0(g_0)$. For finite $E$, use ordinary derived change of completed coefficient sheaves $C_{E/0,W}=-\otimes^L_{R_{0,W}}R_{E,W}$ and the compact-support and twist comparisons of [det-sp-field-extension-towers]:
$$c_E:C_{E/0,Y}P_0\xrightarrow{\sim}P_EC_{E/0,X},\qquad \theta_E:C_{E/0,X}T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E.$$
Set
$$t_E=C_{E/0,Y}(t_0)\circ c_{E,T_0}^{-1}\circ P_E(\theta_E^{-1}):P_ET_E\longrightarrow\mathbf1_{E,Y}.$$
Let $\Pi_{E,K}:P_E(Lf_E^*K\widehat\otimes^LT_E)\xrightarrow{\sim}K\widehat\otimes^LP_ET_E$ denote inverse projection with tensor symmetries. Define $\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}$ to be the adjoint transpose, under the specified $P_E\dashv G_E$, of $(1_K\widehat\otimes t_E)\circ\Pi_{E,K}$, with the twist reassociation and unit constraints understood.

Then $g_0=a^T_0$, $t_E=\epsilon_{E,\mathbf1}\circ P_E(a^T_E)$, and
$$\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}=\gamma^T_{E,K}$$
as integral derived morphisms, for every finite $E$ and every indicated $K$. In particular, if $Q_E$ is scalar localization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], let $\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}$ be the previously specified rational purity family of [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity], whose integral representatives are the simultaneous integral family of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality] in its trace-transpose form, that is, the maps $\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}$ above for some such $g_0$. Then $\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}$ satisfies
$$\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}_{f,Q_EK}=Q_E(\gamma^T_{E,K})$$
under the canonical source and counit-preserving target identifications. The coefficient comparisons in this equality are precisely those of [det-sp-field-extension-towers], and equality remains true for their common-stage images [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category].

source.place: Clause (1), rank-one uniqueness ('a map of rank-one tower sheaves is determined by its levels'), and clause (2), projection-and-counit transpose; compared with sk-lem-sp-field-extension/sk-lem-sp-field-extension-towers clauses (2)-(3) and sk-thm-purity-transport/thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity proof Steps 1-2
source.note: Agent comparison lemma required by the return C4/E5. The unit orientation is compared using its shifted rank-one source; the conclusion does not assert faithfulness of separate evaluations on general derived morphisms.

proof.text: At the coefficient-tower level, [det-sp-tower-gamma] supplies the diagonal orientation a_\bullet with the stated finite-level components and defines the tower purity maps as the adjoint transposes of the projection-formula and counit composite. The derived-limit adjunction of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection] identifies the integral right adjoint H_{f,\mathcal O_E} with the derived limit of the tower right adjoint and identifies its integral purity map with R\lim of those tower purity maps. The realization comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization] identify this derived-limit construction with the fixed compactification expressions P_E and H_{f,\mathcal O_E}; transporting through the counit-preserving comparison gives the displayed integral map \gamma^T_{E,K}, and its finite reductions are the prescribed finite purity maps.

source.place: Proof clauses (1)-(2), diagonal orientation and tensor transpose; compare the integral-adjunction construction in sk-prop-sp-integral-adjunction

proof.text: The tower-derived-limit right adjoint H_{f,\mathcal O_E} and the specified exceptional right adjoint G_E have the same compact-support functor and counit after the canonical realization comparisons. By [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], there is a unique counit-preserving comparison \delta_E:H_{f,\mathcal O_E}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E. Composing the derived-limit tower map with this comparison is exactly the definition of \gamma^T_{E,K}; applying it at the unit object gives a^T_E and preserves the counit equation.

source.place: Proof clause (2), tensor transpose under the tower adjunction, followed by the counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison

proof.text: Work at the coefficient field $0=\mathbf Q_\ell$, where $\varpi_0=\ell$, so the uniformizer levels of [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction] and the $\ell$-power tower levels coincide. By [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], composition with $\delta_0^{-1}$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(T_0,G_0\mathbf1_{0,Y})\to\operatorname{Hom}(T_0,H_{f,\mathbf Z_\ell}\mathbf1_{0,Y})$. [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection] gives a bijection $\beta_M:\operatorname{Hom}(M,H_{f,\mathbf Z_\ell}K)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathbf Z_\ell))}(\operatorname{red}_XM,f^!_\bullet\operatorname{red}_YK)$, natural in $M$; naturality in $M$ applied to $h=1_{H K}\circ h$ gives $\beta_M(h)=\beta_{HK}(1)\circ\operatorname{red}_X(h)$, where $\beta_{HK}(1):\operatorname{red}_XH_{f,\mathbf Z_\ell}K\xrightarrow{\sim}f^!_\bullet\operatorname{red}_YK$ is the reduction comparison of that node. Hence, by the exact level evaluation of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] (2), the level-$n$ component of $\beta(h)$ is the finite reduction of $h$ under the specified reduction comparisons. Take $M=T_0$, $K=\mathbf1_{0,Y}$, and compose with the inverse of the tower orientation $a_\bullet$ of [det-sp-tower-gamma] (1) and the shift $[-2d]$: put $u=a_\bullet^{-1}\circ\beta(\delta_0^{-1}g_0)$ and $v=a_\bullet^{-1}\circ\beta(\delta_0^{-1}a^T_0)$, endomorphisms in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathbf Z_\ell))$ of $L_\bullet=(\mathbf Z_\ell/\ell^\bullet)_X(d)$ placed in degree zero (the reduction of $\mathbf1_{0,X}(d)$ is this rank-one tower sheaf, $\widehat{\mathbf Z}_{\ell,X}$ being flat over $\mathbf Z_\ell$). By hypothesis the level-$n$ component of $\beta(\delta_0^{-1}g_0)$ is the finite unit-object purity map $\gamma_{f,\mathbf Z/\ell^n}(\mathbf Z/\ell^n)$ of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]; by Step 1 ([det-sp-tower-gamma] (2) and the reduction clause of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]) so is that of $\beta(\delta_0^{-1}a^T_0)$. So $u_n=v_n$ in $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\mathbf Z/\ell^n)$ for all $n\geq1$. $\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathbf Z_\ell)$ is abelian [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], so by [lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful] $u,v$ are the images of tower morphisms $\varphi,\psi:L_\bullet\to L_\bullet$; level evaluation is exact, so $u_n,v_n$ are the images of the sheaf maps $\varphi_n,\psi_n$, and faithfulness of the same leaf for $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\mathbf Z/\ell^n)$ gives $\varphi_n=\psi_n$. A morphism of towers is its family of components [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], so $\varphi=\psi$, $u=v$, and since $a_\bullet$, $\beta$ and composition with $\delta_0^{-1}$ are bijective, $g_0=a^T_0$. Consequently the trace defined from $g_0$ is $t_0=\epsilon_{0,\mathbf1}\circ P_0(a^T_0)$, with the same unit constraints as in the tower construction.

source.place: Proof clause (1), rank-one uniqueness: a map of rank-one tower sheaves is determined by its levels; written out through the integral/tower Hom bijection of sk-prop-sp-integral-adjunction and the single-complex full faithfulness

proof.text: For a finite extension E/\mathbf Q_\ell, [det-sp-field-extension-towers] carries the compact-support functor, its unit and counit, and the integral purity maps from the 0-coefficient stage to the E-stage, with the stated tensor associativity. Applying its counit compatibility to t_0=\epsilon_{0,\mathbf1}P_0(a^T_0) gives t_E=\epsilon_{E,\mathbf1}\circ P_E(a^T_E). The same coefficient comparison identifies the displayed maps c_E and \theta_E with the canonical scalar-extension comparisons, so the formula for t_E in the statement is exactly the scalar-extended trace formula.

source.place: Proof clauses (2)-(3), derived-limit coefficient comparisons carry units, counits and purity maps

proof.text: Write $\Pi'_{E,K}$ for the inverse projection map for $\omega=G_E\mathbf1_{E,Y}$ [def-exchange-projection]. By Steps 1-2, $\gamma^T_{E,K}$ is $\delta_E\circ R\lim$ of the tower maps of [det-sp-tower-gamma] (2), and the realization comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization] carry the tower projection maps, counits and their transposes to the integral ones; since $\delta_E$ preserves counits [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], $\gamma^T_{E,K}$ is the $G_E$-transpose of $(1_K\widehat\otimes\epsilon_{E,\mathbf1})\circ\Pi'_{E,K}\circ P_E(1\widehat\otimes a^T_E)$, with the twist reassociation understood. Naturality of the projection map in its second variable [def-exchange-projection] gives $\Pi'_{E,K}\circ P_E(1\widehat\otimes a^T_E)=(1_K\widehat\otimes P_E(a^T_E))\circ\Pi_{E,K}$, so this composite is $(1_K\widehat\otimes\epsilon_{E,\mathbf1}P_E(a^T_E))\circ\Pi_{E,K}=(1_K\widehat\otimes t_E)\circ\Pi_{E,K}$ by Step 4. The adjunction hom-bijection of $P_E\dashv G_E$ is injective, so the two transposes agree: $\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}=\gamma^T_{E,K}$.

source.place: Proof clause (2), tensor map is the transpose of the projection-formula and counit composite

proof.text: Finally, scalar localization and finite coefficient-field transport carry the integral equality just proved to the rational categories. [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity] identifies the rational and algebraically closed purity families with scalar extensions of the adic family, while [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality] supplies the simultaneous natural integral family and its coefficient equations. Applying the rational part of [det-sp-field-extension-towers] gives \gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}_{f,Q_EK}=Q_E(\gamma^T_{E,K}); the same comparison and the definition of the common-stage category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] identify the source and counit-preserving target maps, so the equality remains true after passage to common-stage images.

source.place: Proof transport from adic purity by scalar localization and finite coefficient extension

split_report.summary: Audited the imported comparison statement against the tower-gamma, integral-adjunction, field-extension, and purity-transport interfaces. Added one strictly smaller levelwise uniqueness lemma for degree-zero rank-one tower maps, then wrote the six-step comparison from tower orientation through the counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison, scalar trace, adjoint transpose, and rational/common-stage transport. Maintainer reader (2026-10-18): the new levelwise-uniqueness node assumed the tower-sheaf representation that the step needed and was a two-line consequence of the definitions; it is folded into Step 3, which now passes from the integral map g_0 to tower maps through the Hom bijection of det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection and the counit-preserving comparison, and uses the single-complex full faithfulness leaf lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful. Step 5 now writes the projection-naturality computation and is no longer marked elementary.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the comparison sentence attached to prop-weil-operations, using the tower-gamma proof clauses (1)-(2), the field-extension tower proof clauses (2)-(3), and the rational purity transport proof.

tool_uses.why: The item compares its tower orientation and tensor transpose with a reconstructed trace map; this tower construction is the generic geometric input.
The integral map is obtained by the derived-limit adjunction and its counit, which the finite unit sk-lem-finite does not provide.
The item explicitly compares the tower-derived right adjoint with the specified exceptional right adjoint by counit preservation.
The trace and purity maps are transported through finite coefficient-field extension, including units, counits and associativity.
The final rational and common-stage conclusion uses the stated scalar transport of adic purity.
The item invokes the simultaneous natural integral purity family in its trace-transpose form.
Steps 1-3 and 5 identify the tower/system projection maps, counits and transposes with the integral compact-support ones; no node of sk-lem-finite gives these realizations.
Step 3 uses that Tow(X,Z_l) is abelian with exact level evaluation, to apply the single-complex full faithfulness; this is a tower-category fact outside sk-lem-finite.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NB-a9f664368 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all of it: the item, the new node, every cited statement, the tower-gamma proof clauses (1)-(3) in main-20261015, the field-extension and purity-transport sources, and unit sk-lem-finite. The item statement is unchanged from the base and is not weakened. The coefficient category throughout is the derived-complete integral one, with ordinary derived change of completed rings as in det-sp-field-extension-towers. No SGA source is cited. The claim g_0=a^T_0 is true: Hom(T_0,G_0 1) is H^0(X,Z_l^), and the lim^1 term of H^{-1}(X,Z/l^n) vanishes. Edge cases X empty, d=0 and X disconnected all hold. Steps 1, 2, 4 and 6 are correct as citations of statements. Fault 1 (C1/E5), Step 3: it treated the integral g_0 as a tower map without citing the Hom bijection of det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection or the counit-preserving comparison of det-sp-unique-right-adjoint; the realization lemma it did cite explicitly asserts no faithfulness on morphisms. Repaired: Step 3 now goes through delta_0, uses naturality of beta to show beta(h)=beta(1)∘red(h), and finishes with Tow abelian with exact levels (det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian), the single-complex full-faithfulness leaf lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful, and the fact that a tower map is its family of components. Fault 2 (D1/C1): the new node lem-pur-tower-rank-one-level-uniqueness assumed in its hypothesis the tower-sheaf representation that Step 3 needed, so it was trivial. Its useful form is a few lines from the existing leaf, so I folded it into Step 3, dropped it, and removed it from stmt_deps, where it had been listed although the statement does not use it. Fault 3 (C2): Step 5 was marked elementary while relying on the realization lemma. I wrote out the projection-naturality computation, added det-sp-unique-right-adjoint to its uses, and set elementary=false. I accepted two more tool uses: lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization and det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian. The corrected item is under fixes/dag/nodes/sec-poincare-duality/.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
